# wgpu-native v29.0.1.1

Prebuilt Windows x86_64 release of [wgpu-native](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu-native) (tag `v29.0.1.1`):
`include/`, `lib/wgpu_native.dll` and its import library, unmodified. The static library and debug symbols of the
release are left out.
